desc: Secure handguns and other valuables with convenient access with the fast, dependable touch-free entry of Rapid Safe and its RFID technology. Hornady Rapid Safe Keypad Vault gives you three entry methods- RFID reader, access code and mechanical key. Big enough for two handguns but small enough to fit in a drawer or on a shelf. Features heavy duty steel construction and pre-drilled holes for permanent mounting.
